nodes.name: Decision Engine.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph module node (MOD-002, canonical_id) documenting the Decision Engine — the algorithmic core of the Supervisor Office that scores upgrade options under treasury constraints and emits a deterministic decision packet, currently active and tested.
nodes.languageNotes: Ontology-governed Engineering Digital Twin node with structured YAML frontmatter, canonical_id MOD-002, and a full Relationships section covering Implements, Consumes, Produces, Contains, Validated By, Realizes, Justified By, and Originates From.

nodes.name: Execution.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph module node (MOD-008) documenting the Execution module — the first money-shaped Layer-3 module that consumes an ADMIT RuntimeDecisionRecord and produces an ExecutionRecord plus updated PortfolioState via a deterministic, replay-safe simulated-broker core.
nodes.languageNotes: Canonical module node with canonical_id MOD-008; documents ADR-011 bounded-context discipline, determinism boundary between engine.py (pure) and runtime.py (IO), and BENCH-004 byte-identical replay invariant.

nodes.name: Feature Builder.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph module node (MOD-004) documenting the Feature Builder — a deterministic, snapshot-local transform that converts a validated Layer-2 Snapshot into a frozen, provenance-tagged feature vector (SCHEMA-009) with 14 macro features, currently active and tested.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents the FEATURE_REGISTRY pattern (name-sorted, pure-function specs mirroring the guardrail predicate-tuple convention) and the ADR-005 forbidden feature classes (no history, momentum, rolling windows).

nodes.name: Gold Decision Builder.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph module node (MOD-006) documenting the Gold Decision Builder — a deterministic, snapshot-local builder that turns a FeatureVector and RegimeClassification into a frozen GoldDecisionPacket (SCHEMA-011) encoding direction, confidence, uncertainty, and cited features for paper-trading consumption.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents ADR-008 confidence semantics (ordinal trust score, not a probability), the fail-closed INDETERMINATE→WATCH path, and the SHA-256 packet_id determinism invariant mirroring Snapshot.recompute_id.

nodes.name: Guardrail Engine.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph module node (MOD-001) documenting the Guardrail Engine — the risk-control boundary that evaluates a conjunction of hard-limit trade-validation predicates and returns a single deterministic APPROVE/BLOCK decision, implemented as a fail-closed, synchronous external validator.
nodes.languageNotes: Earliest module in the registry (MOD-001); implements the Guardrail Pattern (external validator the trading agent cannot reason around) with short-circuit conjunction predicate evaluation and fail-closed config loading.

nodes.name: Market Regime Classifier.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph module node (MOD-005) documenting the Market Regime Classifier — a deterministic, snapshot-local priority-ordered rule engine that classifies a FeatureVector into one of 12 market regime classes (SCHEMA-010), forming the third stage of the Layer-3 analysis pipeline.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents the RULE_TABLE declarative priority-ordered structure mirroring MOD-004's FEATURE_REGISTRY; classifies into 12 regimes including INDETERMINATE as fail-closed terminal; governed by ADR-007 Deterministic Regime Taxonomy.

nodes.name: Paper-Trading Runtime.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph module node (MOD-007) documenting the Paper-Trading Runtime — the first stateful Layer-3 component that admits a pure GoldDecisionPacket against explicit runtime state (ledger + operational input), computes two stateful L3 guards, and emits a RuntimeDecisionRecord with ADMIT/HOLD/REJECT verdict.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents the wrap-never-enrich-in-place pattern (guard outcomes on the record, not the packet), the pure-core/IO-at-the-edge separation mirroring Execution (MOD-008), and 50 tests including BENCH-003 synthetic verdict sweep.

nodes.name: Snapshot Consumer.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph module node (MOD-003) documenting the Snapshot Consumer — the Layer-2 to Layer-3 ingestion boundary that reads the truth snapshot and applies a fail-closed gate, ensuring no downstream stage ever re-implements the 'is this snapshot safe to use?' check.
nodes.languageNotes: First in the Layer-3 data path (SCHEMA-001 → MOD-003 → features → decision); implements CQRS and Pipeline patterns; mode 2 DB-query replay deferred; uses stdlib-only zero-runtime-dependency constraint (ADR-003).
